name: ComPatch Grey's + Morgenroete
short_description: grey_usu ships its own Morgenroete compat already, so 31 of 35 shared keys are already correctly merged there. Three real gaps survive: building_government_administration silently drops Morgenroete's pmg_panum_hospital from the group list (grey_usu's own author left the fix commented out in their file), five RU_BL_* Russian-declension routing tables lose Morgenroete's 30 buildings when grey_usu's bare full body eats Morgenroete's REPLACE: whole, and pm_nr_national_park silently drops a standard-of-living field on rebuild. This restores all three, read live out of both mods' own files. Load after the whole Grey's pack.
